description: This file declares the VersionScriptParser class used for parsing version scripts in the header-checker component of the Android project. It includes class definitions, method declarations, and internal data structures related to parsing and handling version script syntax and symbols.

classes.name: VersionScriptParser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing version scripts, managing symbol exclusions, and handling errors within the header-checker tool.

classes.name: VersionScriptParser::ErrorHandler
classes.description: An interface for handling errors encountered during parsing of version scripts.

methods.name: SetArch
methods.description: Sets the architecture for parsing context.

methods.name: SetApiLevel
methods.description: Sets the API level for parsing context.

methods.name: AddExcludedSymbolVersion
methods.description: Adds a symbol version to the exclusion list.

methods.name: AddExcludedSymbolTag
methods.description: Adds a symbol tag to the exclusion list.

methods.name: SetErrorHandler
methods.description: Assigns an error handler for parsing errors.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a version script input stream and returns a set of exported symbols.

methods.name: ReadLine
methods.description: Reads a line from the input stream.

methods.name: ParseVersionBlock
methods.description: Parses a version block in the script.

methods.name: ParseSymbolLine
methods.description: Parses a line representing a symbol.

methods.name: ParseSymbolTags
methods.description: Parses tags associated with a symbol.

methods.name: IsSymbolExported
methods.description: Determines if a symbol should be exported based on tags.

methods.name: ReportError
methods.description: Reports an error via the error handler.
